name: Chart metric card
purpose: A summary metric, explicit comparison, latest readout, and underlying bar, area, or compact-bar series.
description: A summary metric and its underlying series in one card. Bar and area variants retain the shared chart keyboard inspection and tooltips. Compact bars are a static overview; every variant exposes an exact data table. The latest readout comes from the final supplied interval. Example values are illustrative, sum to 61,800, and end at 9,700 on Oct 21; the +364.3% comparison is supplied separately. The example explicitly marks that comparison favorable for presentation, not as a business performance assessment.

props.name: color
props.description: Shared semantic color for the series. Individual full-size bars may override it through data.color.

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered oldest to newest. Compact bars require non-negative values.

props.name: delta
props.description: Percentage change; its desirability is independent of its direction.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels; defaults to 220, or 80 for compact bars.

props.name: metric
props.description: Summary metric, which may be a total, rate, or other caller-defined aggregation.

props.name: trendIsPositive
props.description: Omit for a neutral change. Set explicitly when the change is favorable or unfavorable.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats numeric summary, latest value, chart ticks, and tooltips. The data table stays exact.

guidance.overview: A summary metric, explicit comparison, latest readout, and underlying bar, area, or compact-bar series.
usage: Supply data oldest to newest; the last datum becomes the latest readout. metric is caller-defined and is not automatically summed from data.
Set trendIsPositive only when the change has a known favorable or unfavorable meaning. Omission keeps the comparison neutral.
Use finite values; compact bars require non-negative values. Per-datum color applies to the full bar variant, while area and compact variants use the series color.
accessibility: Every variant exposes exact values through a native chart-data disclosure; full-size plots also support keyboard inspection.
Formatted summary and tooltip values do not replace the exact numbers in the data table.
context: Use when users need to connect an aggregate KPI to the interval data beneath it.
